name: Settlement Music School Wynnefield Summer Jazz Camp
description_short: One week jazz camp for ages 12 to 18 at Settlement Music School's Wynnefield Branch, 9 to 3 daily, where students work on jazz harmony and improvisation with the school's faculty, play in a group and give a final performance on the last day.
notes: $590 for the week plus Settlement's $5 registration fee; one price for everyone. Settlement's other summer offerings at its branches are weekly evening classes, not camps, so they are not listed.
